annotation.title_clean: 人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の推進に関する法律案
annotation.title_en: Act on Promotion of Research and Development and Utilization of Artificial Intelligence-Related Technologies (Japan AI Promotion Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Shugiin (House of Representatives of Japan), 217th Diet session
annotation.summary_en: Japan's AI Promotion Act, shown on the House of Representatives site (text garbled by encoding). It sets basic principles, duties of the state, local governments, research institutions and businesses, and creates an AI Strategy Headquarters under the Cabinet to draft a Basic AI Plan. It is promotion-oriented and includes investigation of misuse and international cooperation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes basic principles for promoting AI research, development and utilization, linked to economic security and national interests
Creates the AI Strategy Headquarters, headed by the Prime Minister, within the Cabinet
Requires a government Basic AI Plan approved by Cabinet
Obliges the government to investigate and respond to improper AI use, such as crime, privacy leaks and copyright infringement
Promotes international cooperation, norm-making, education and transparency of AI development processes
